detail: On a fixture or manifest conflict, take the target's version and regenerate in one 'regen after rebase onto <hash>' commit; resolve the intermediate commits' findings with fixed-by. xtask land lets an intermediate fail verify only for stale fixtures, only when the tip is the regen commit and passes the full gate; tests, clippy and parity run on every commit.
title: A rebase over fixtures regenerates once at the tip; intermediates may fail only on stale fixtures
